title: Trainer AI
intro: This document explains what a trainer will do on a given turn: how it scores its moves, when it switches, and which Pokémon it sends in. It follows the layout of the Pokémon Run & Bun AI document, but every number here comes from Black Pearl Emerald's own battle code (the pokeemerald-expansion AI plus BPE's changes). Black Pearl Emerald's AI is different from Run & Bun's, so their scores do not carry over.

Every move starts with a score of 100. The rules below add to or subtract from it: "+6" means 106 if nothing else applies. The trainer uses the move with the highest final score, and picks at random between moves that tie.

This is not an exhaustive list of every move. The AI also has a basic check that throws out moves that would fail or do nothing (Stealth Rock when it is already up, Thunder Wave on a Pokémon that is already paralyzed, and so on). Those obvious cases are not listed; the ones that are not obvious are in "Moves the AI avoids".

entries.name: Picking a move
rules: Every usable move starts at 100. A move it cannot select this turn (no PP, Disabled, Taunted, locked out by Encore or a Choice item) starts at 0 and is never used.
The score is built in this order:
Check Bad Move: penalties for moves that fail or waste the turn. A score never drops below 0.
Try To Faint: bonuses for moves that KO.
Check Viability: bonuses and penalties for each move's effect.
Double Battle rules (Double Battles only).
Best damaging move: +1 for the attack that KOs in the fewest hits.
The highest score is used. If several moves tie, one of them is picked at random.
In Double Battles every move is scored against each target separately, and the best move and target pair is used. A move aimed at its own partner needs a score of at least 100.

entries.name: What the AI knows
rules: Trainers are Omniscient: from the start of the battle they know your whole party, including species, held items, Abilities and all four moves of every Pokémon.
It reads exact HP, stats and stat stages.
It does not predict your move. Where a rule below mentions "your last move", the AI is looking at the last move your Pokémon used.

entries.name: Damage the AI assumes
rules: Its own attacks: the highest damage roll.
Your attacks on it: the median roll (93%).
When deciding whether to set up: your highest roll.
Critical hits count only for moves that always crit (Frost Breath, Wicked Blow, a Laser Focus turn).
2-5 hit moves count as 5 hits.
A Pokémon at full HP with Focus Sash, Sturdy, an intact Disguise, or Ice Face against a physical move, is assumed to survive, unless the move hits more than once.
Resist berries: if the halved hit plus a second full hit would KO, the AI ignores the berry when looking for KOs.

entries.name: Speed
rules: Move priority is compared first. Your move always counts as priority 0, because the AI does not predict it.
Then Lagging Tail, Full Incense and Stall, which make their holder slower.
Then actual Speed, including paralysis, Choice Scarf, Abilities, Tailwind and stat stages. Trick Room reverses it.
The AI sees speed ties as it being faster.
One exception: for the last-chance priority bonus (see "All damaging moves"), a speed tie counts as the AI being slower.

entries.name: Which trainers use this AI
rules: Every trainer uses Check Bad Move, Try To Faint, Check Viability, Smart Switching, Smart Mon Choices and Omniscient.
A few have something extra or less:
Leader Dan and Leader CMT (every fight with them): Will Suicide.
Champion Pantelis: Prefer Status Moves and Ace Pokémon.
One Team Aqua Grunt in the Aqua Hideout: Ace Pokémon, but no Smart Switching, Smart Mon Choices or Omniscient.
See "Special trainers" for what these do.
No trainer uses items (Potions, X items) in battle.

entries.name: Common scores to be aware of

rows: Best damaging move (fewest hits to KO)
Slow kill (AI KOs but is slower)
Fast kill (AI KOs and is faster*)
Fast kill that is also the best damaging move
Last-chance priority move (AI would be KO'd and is slower)
Typical status move bonus (hazards, screens, status, setup)
Status move with no special rule
Move fails or its effect cannot apply

notes: *The AI sees speed ties as it being faster.

Unlike Run & Bun, the strongest attack only gets +1. A status move with a +2 or better bonus therefore beats an attack that does not KO, which is why trainers often set up, set hazards or inflict status when they cannot KO you.

sections.title: Switch AI

entries.name: When the AI never switches
rules: It is trapped: bound, Mean Looked or Blocked, rooted by Ingrain, or caught by your Shadow Tag, Arena Trap or Magnet Pull (Ghost types are exempt). Shed Shell is not considered.
It has no healthy Pokémon in the back. The Ace Pokémon never counts.
It would faint to entry hazards when it later came back in, and no party member has a hazard-removal move. Every reason below except Wonder Guard is skipped.

entries.name: Reasons to switch
text: Checked in this order; the first one that applies decides. "Stats raised" means a raised Attack or Sp. Atk it can use, or any Speed boost.
rules: Wonder Guard (singles): your Pokémon has Wonder Guard and the AI has no super-effective move:
100% to switch. Without a good switch-in it sends the last party member with a super-effective attack, and stays in if there is none.
Trapper: a party member has Shadow Tag, Arena Trap (you are grounded) or Magnet Pull (you are Steel), you can still switch, and that Pokémon is its chosen switch-in:
100% to switch

Absorber: the move you used last turn would be absorbed by a party member's Ability (Flash Fire, Water Absorb, Volt Absorb, Lightning Rod, Sap Sipper, Levitate, Soundproof, Bulletproof, Wind Rider, Overcoat, and similar), and the active Pokémon lacks it:
100% to switch to that Pokémon
Not if it came in this turn, has +3 or more total stat stages, wins the 1v1, or you have Mold Breaker
Stays in 66% of the time if it has a super-effective move against you
Ignores Hidden Power 50% of the time
Free turn (singles): you are charging a two-turn move or are in the air or underground, and it does not win the 1v1:
50% to switch, with a good switch-in
Truant: it is on its loafing turn, has at least 1/2 HP, has a good switch-in, and you have used Protect-type or semi-invulnerable moves:
100% to switch
All moves useless: none of its moves can affect you (one usable status move is enough to stay):
100% to switch. Without a good switch-in it sends the last party member with an attack that is at least neutral, and stays if there is none.
Perish Song on its last turn and no Soundproof:
100% to switch, even without a good switch-in
Yawn: it is drowsy, can fall asleep, has more than 1/3 HP and has a good switch-in:
100% to switch
Stays in if it expects to KO you first, has Natural Cure, Shed Skin or Early Bird, holds a Chesto or Lum Berry, knows Sleep Talk, or can set Misty or Electric Terrain
Damaging status, with a good switch-in, no Magic Guard, and no expected KO on you first:
Toxic for 2+ turns, at least 1/3 HP: 50% (20% with stats raised)
Ghost-type Curse: 50% (20% with stats raised)
Nightmare: 33% (15% with stats raised)
Leech Seed: 25% (10% with stats raised)
Infatuation: 100%
Natural Cure, with a good switch-in:
Asleep, frozen or badly poisoned: 66% (10% with stats raised)
Any other status with at least 1/2 HP: 25% (10% with stats raised)
Regenerator: no status, 2/3 HP or less, good switch-in:
50% (20% with stats raised)
Intimidate: your Pokémon looks physical (its strongest move against the AI is physical, or it last used one) and Intimidate would work on it, with a good switch-in:
25% (10% with stats raised)
Zero to Hero (Palafin): switches out to transform, unless it can use a pivot move first.
Passing a Wish (singles): a Wish is coming, the AI has a bad type matchup and does not win the 1v1, and the switch-in would recover more than 1/4 of its HP:
Bad odds (singles), with a good switch-in and if it does not win the 1v1:
You can OHKO it and it has at least 1/2 HP (1/4 with Regenerator): 50%

Your types hit it harder than neutral, it has no super-effective move, it has at least 1/2 HP (1/4 with Regenerator), and it has no important status move (hazards, screens, sleep, Toxic, paralysis, burn, Yawn, Leech Seed, Trick Room, Trick, Explosion, Fake Out...): 50%
Encore:
Encored into a status move: 100%, even without a good switch-in
Encored into an attack that is not super effective, with a good switch-in: 50%
Choice item locked into a status move, or into a move that cannot affect you:
100%, even without a good switch-in
Stat drops on its main attacking stat (Attack if higher than Sp. Atk, otherwise Sp. Atk):
-2, with a good switch-in: 50%
-3 or lower: 100%, even without a good switch-in

entries.name: After scoring its moves
rules: If every move scores 90 or less:
100% to switch, even without a good switch-in. A single -10 penalty is enough to make a move "bad" here.
If it decided to switch but has U-turn, Volt Switch, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Baton Pass, Teleport, Chilly Reception, Shed Tail or Revival Blessing scoring above 100:
Uses that move instead of switching
notes: Natural Cure Pokémon that are burned with only physical attacks, or frostbitten with only special attacks, get -20 on every move, which makes them switch this way.

entries.name: Winning the 1v1
rules: The AI compares how many of your hits it takes to faint with how many of its hits you take, using its best move.
If it moves first, it wins when it can take at least as many hits as it needs. If it moves second, it needs to take more.
It must also win against your best priority move.
Type matchup: your Pokémon's own types (not its moves) against the AI's types, adding the two multipliers (an immunity counts as 0.1). Neutral is 2.0; above is a bad matchup, below is a good one.

entries.name: Choosing the next Pokémon after a faint
text: Also used after its own U-turn or Volt Switch when it moved second, and after Eject Button. The switch-in is simulated on the field, counting entry hazards, weather, status damage, Leftovers, healing berries, Focus Sash, Sturdy and Disguise. A free switch-in "wins" if it takes more hits to faint than it needs, or the same number and it is faster. The first group that has a Pokémon wins:
rules: A trapper (Shadow Tag, Arena Trap, Magnet Pull) that wins the 1v1
A faster Pokémon that OHKOs you and wins the 1v1
A slower Pokémon that OHKOs you and wins the 1v1
A faster Pokémon that 2HKOs you and wins the 1v1
A slower Pokémon that 2HKOs you and wins the 1v1
Good type matchup with a super-effective move, wins the 1v1 (best matchup first)
Good type matchup, wins the 1v1 (best matchup first)
Gains more than 1/4 of its HP from a pending Wish, Healing Wish or Lunar Dance
Knows Baton Pass and survives long enough to use it (2 of your hits if faster, 3 if slower)
Any Pokémon that wins the 1v1
The one that does the most damage with one move, if it survives your best hit
The last remaining Pokémon in party order
The Ace, once nothing else is left
notes: Ties among trappers, OHKOs, 2HKOs, Baton Pass users and 1v1 winners go to the Pokémon later in the party. Ties for best matchup or damage go to the earlier one. Explosion-type moves only count for a revenge kill if they OHKO.

entries.name: Choosing a mid-battle switch-in
text: When it switches by choice, the incoming Pokémon takes a hit, so it must take at least 2 more hits than it needs to KO you (or exactly 1 more and be faster). The first group that has a Pokémon wins:
rules: A trapper that wins the 1v1
Good type matchup with a super-effective move, wins the 1v1
Good type matchup, wins the 1v1
Defensive: takes 4 or more of your hits and wins the 1v1 (the bulkiest first)
Gains from a pending Wish, Healing Wish or Lunar Dance
A Baton Pass user
Any Pokémon that wins the 1v1
notes: If none qualifies there is no good switch-in, and the reasons that need one do not trigger. Reasons that switch anyway send in the last Pokémon in party order.

entries.name: Double Battles
rules: Several switch reasons are singles-only (Wonder Guard, free turn, Wish, bad odds).
The switch-in is chosen more simply:
A Pokémon that knows Baton Pass
A Pokémon with a super-effective move and a better than neutral type matchup
The Pokémon that does the most damage with one move
The last Pokémon in party order, then the Ace

intro: Before scoring its moves each turn, the AI checks whether it should switch out. Most reasons need a "good switch-in": a Pokémon its switch-in search (below) is happy to bring in.

entries.name: All damaging moves
rules: If the move KOs:
If AI is faster (priority counts, speed ties count as faster):
Additional +6
If AI is slower:
Additional +4
Else, if you can KO the AI, the AI is slower (a tie counts as slower), and the move has priority:
Additional +6 (50%), +2 (50%)
In Double Battles: always +2

If the move cannot damage the target (type immunity, absorbing Ability, priority into Dazzling, Queenly Majesty, Armor Tail or Psychic Terrain, Dream Eater on an awake target, Poltergeist on no item...):
notes: Explosion-type moves, Final Gambit and Memento only count as KOs when the AI has decided to sacrifice itself this turn (see Explosion).

entries.name: Best damaging move
rules: After everything else, the AI counts how many hits each attack needs to KO.
If one attack needs the fewest hits:
Additional +1
If several tie, they are compared in pairs. Each tiebreaker outweighs every one below it:
Not weakened by a resist berry (when both OHKO)
Not a two-turn charging move (Solar Beam without sun or Power Herb, Sky Attack, Meteor Beam...)
A priority move that outspeeds when the other does not (when both OHKO)
Not a self-KO move
Still KOs on the lowest roll (when both OHKO)
Higher accuracy (moves that cannot miss count as 101%)
Better side effect
The move that wins the most comparisons gets +1. If none wins anything, all of the tied moves get +1.
notes: Side effects: against Rocky Helmet, Iron Barbs or Rough Skin the non-contact move wins. Otherwise a drawback loses (recoil, recharge, lowering its own stats like Close Combat or Draco Meteor, draining into Liquid Ooze) and a bonus wins (draining when not at full HP, raising its own stats, a chance to poison, burn, freeze, paralyze, confuse or flinch, lowering your stats).

entries.name: Guaranteed side effects
text: A side effect only adds to the score when it is guaranteed (100%, or 100% after Serene Grace). Sheer Force skips them, and Shield Dust or Covert Cloak blocks effects on the target.
rules: Raises the AI's own stats (Flame Charge, Power-Up Punch, Trailblaze...):
Same score as a setup move (see "Setup moves")
Lowers your stats (Icy Wind, Electroweb, Snarl, Lunge, Mystical Fire, Trop Kick...), per stat:
+0 if the stat is already -3 or lower (except Speed), you will faint to residual damage, you have Defiant, Competitive or Contrary, or the AI can already OHKO you
Attack: +2 if you have a physical move
Sp. Atk: +2 if you have a special move
Defense / Sp. Def: +2 if the AI or its partner has a physical / special move
Speed: +2 if the AI or its partner is slower
At most +4
Poisons you: same score as Toxic
Burns, paralyzes or puts to sleep: +0 (these side effects on attacks are not scored)

entries.name: Priority moves
rules: If you can KO the AI and it is slower: Additional +6 (50%), +2 (50%); always +2 in Double Battles.
Never used when the AI itself is grounded in Psychic Terrain (-20).
notes: The Psychic Terrain check looks at the AI's own Pokémon, not yours: a grounded AI in Psychic Terrain never uses priority moves, even against a Pokémon in the air.

entries.name: Fake Out
rules: Singles, if the AI is faster and the flinch cannot be blocked (no Inner Focus, Shield Dust, Covert Cloak or Substitute):
Additional +2 if you are paralyzed, confused or infatuated, the AI has Serene Grace, or you can KO the AI
On the AI's first turn, if Fake Out is its best damaging move or KOs:
Additional +4
Double Battles, first turn: +2 to +8, highest when it outspeeds an opposing Fake Out user or protects a partner that you could KO first.
After the AI's first turn: -10
Holding a Choice item: -5

entries.name: Sucker Punch
rules: If AI is slower: -10
If you know any status move: -10 (50%), no change other 50%
Otherwise treated as a normal damaging move

entries.name: Explosion, Self-Destruct, Misty Explosion
rules: Each turn the AI rolls whether it is willing to explode:
At 90% HP or more: 0%
At 10% HP or less: 90%
In between: (90 - HP%)%, e.g. 40% at 50% HP
If willing: counts as a KO move like any attack (+6 faster / +4 slower)
If not willing: -5
Into Damp or a target it cannot hit: -10
notes: Will Suicide trainers are always willing and get an additional +2 if your evasion is not raised.

entries.name: Final Gambit
rules: 50% chance each turn that the AI considers it; otherwise -5
Counts as a KO only if the AI is faster and its current HP is at least yours
notes: Will Suicide trainers always consider it and get an additional +2.

entries.name: U-turn, Volt Switch, Flip Turn, Parting Shot
rules: If the AI wants to switch and is faster, or wants to switch, is slower and cannot be KO'd:
If you are at full HP with Focus Sash, Sturdy, Multiscale or Shadow Shield, and it has a good switch-in:
With Regenerator, if healing would help and it has a good switch-in:
Palafin with Zero to Hero and a Pokémon in the back:
If it has no good switch-in:

entries.name: Future Sight, Doom Desire
rules: If one is already coming: -12

entries.name: Focus Punch
rules: -10 if you have any damaging move and are not asleep, frozen, infatuated or confused (unless the AI is behind a Substitute)
-10 if the AI knows Substitute but has none up
-10 if the AI knows a sleep move and you are awake

entries.name: Fell Stinger
rules: If it KOs, the AI's Attack is below +6 and it is not Contrary:
Additional +4 (on top of the KO bonus)

entries.name: Binding moves (Wrap, Fire Spin, Whirlpool, Sand Tomb, Infestation...)
rules: If you have no Rapid Spin, cannot escape, are not already trapped and will faint to residual damage:

entries.name: Knock Off
rules: If your item can be removed: +2
Iron Ball: +2 only if you have Fling. Lagging Tail, Sticky Barb: +0
Into Sticky Hold: -10

entries.name: Rapid Spin, Mortal Spin
rules: If hazards are on the AI's side and it has a Pokémon in the back, or it is Leech Seeded or bound:

entries.name: Brick Break, Psychic Fangs
rules: +2 for each of Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil on your side

entries.name: Throat Chop
rules: If one of your best moves is a sound move:
If AI is faster: +3
If AI is slower: +2

entries.name: Feint
rules: If your last move was Protect: +3

entries.name: Draining moves (Giga Drain, Drain Punch, Horn Leech...)
rules: +2 if draining helps: it is not at full HP, you do not have Liquid Ooze, and the healing lets it survive or win the 1v1 (or it is below 60% HP and cannot be KO'd, 50% of the time)

entries.name: Bug Bite, Pluck, Incinerate
rules: If you hold a Berry (Incinerate: or a Gem): +2

entries.name: Counter, Mirror Coat, Metal Burst
rules: If you are not incapacitated, your last move matches (physical for Counter, special for Mirror Coat), and that move needs 2+ hits to KO the AI: +3
If your last move was a status move, or you have not moved yet: -10
If you are asleep, frozen, infatuated or confused: -1

entries.name: Flail, Reversal
rules: If AI is slower or above 50% HP: -4

entries.name: High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, Supercell Slam
rules: If accuracy is below 75% (and no Magic Guard): -6

entries.name: Two-turn moves (Solar Beam, Sky Attack, Meteor Beam...)
rules: If you can KO the AI: -10

entries.name: OHKO moves (Fissure, Sheer Cold, Guillotine, Horn Drill)
rules: After Lock-On or Mind Reader on you: +4
If it cannot work (Sturdy, Focus Sash at full HP, you are a higher level, or a failed accuracy roll): -10

entries.name: Thawing moves (Scald, Flame Wheel, Flare Blitz...)
rules: If the AI is frozen or frostbitten: +10

entries.name: Dark, Ghost and Bug moves
rules: Damaging Dark move into Justified: -10
Dark, Ghost or Bug move into Rattled: -10

entries.name: Spread moves in Double Battles (Earthquake, Surf, Discharge...)
rules: If the move would KO its own partner (and the partner is not protecting):
If it KOs both of your Pokémon: +10
Else, if both of your Pokémon can KO the partner anyway: +1 if it KOs one of yours, more with Moxie-type Abilities or Receiver
Else, if it KOs one of yours: -3 (+10 for Will Suicide trainers)
Otherwise: -10
If it does not KO the partner, the partner holds Weakness Policy, and the hit is super effective on it but takes more than 3 hits to KO: +3

entries.name: Setup moves (Swords Dance, Dragon Dance, Nasty Plot, Calm Mind, Bulk Up, Quiver Dance, Agility...)
text: Each stat the move raises gets its own score, and the total is capped at +4. "Hits" below means how many of your hits (highest roll) it takes to KO the AI.
rules: Never sets up (+0) if:
You can KO it first: in 1 hit while it is faster, or in 2 hits while it is slower. This applies to every stat, Defense and Sp. Def included
You have Unaware or Opportunist
It would faint to residual damage this turn
Any of your Pokémon has used Haze, Clear Smog or Freezy Frost earlier in the battle
It already has a raised stat and you know a stat-reset move (Haze, Clear Smog...)
It could KO you right now if not for Sturdy, Focus Sash, Disguise or Ice Face
For each stat:
+0 if the stat is already at +4 or higher
+0 if it is faster, you can KO it in 2 hits or fewer, and you have a priority move or a damaging Speed-lowering move
+0 if it is below 70% HP and you have no damaging move
Attack (needs a physical move):
+1 stage: +2
+2 or more stages: +3
+6 stages: +4
Sp. Atk (needs a special move):
+1 stage: +2
+2 or more stages: +3
Speed (only if it is slower and Hits 3+, or you have no attacks):
+1 stage: +2
+2 or more stages: +3
Defense (if you have a physical move or no special move):
+1 stage: +1
+2 or more stages: +2
With Body Press: +2 / +3 instead
Sp. Def (if you have a special move or no physical move):
+1 stage: +1
+2 or more stages: +2
With Stored Power:
Additional +1 for each stat that scored
notes: Simple doubles the stages. Accuracy and Evasion boosts are never scored, so Double Team, Minimize and the accuracy half of Coil and Hone Claws give +0.
The KO check also covers attacks that raise the AI's own stats (Flame Charge, Power-Up Punch): their boost adds nothing when you can KO it first.

entries.name: Shell Smash, Curse (non-Ghost)
rules: Scored like other setup moves, up to +4
notes: The AI reads the stats these moves lower (Shell Smash's Defense and Sp. Def, Curse's Speed) as if they were raised, so they score as extra boosts. The +4 cap limits the effect.

entries.name: Belly Drum, Fillet Away
rules: Only if your best hit does less than 50% of the AI's max HP (or its Disguise or Ice Face is intact)
Then scored as a maximum Attack boost: +3 if the Attack conditions above are met

entries.name: Clangorous Soul
rules: Only if your best hit does less than 33% of the AI's max HP, then scored like other setup moves

entries.name: Focus Energy, Laser Focus
rules: If the AI has Super Luck, Sniper, a Scope Lens or a high-crit move: +3
Else: +0

entries.name: Stockpile, Charge, Defense Curl
rules: Stockpile: +2 if it has Spit Up or Swallow, plus the defensive setup score
Charge: +2 if it has a damaging Electric move, plus the Sp. Def score
Defense Curl: +2 if it has Rollout or Ice Ball and has not curled yet, plus the Defense score

entries.name: Geomancy
rules: Only with a Power Herb, then scored like other setup moves

sections.title: Status moves

entries.name: Encore bait
rules: If any of your Pokémon on the field knows Encore, most status moves get no bonuses at all (+0): setup, Thunder Wave, Toxic, Will-O-Wisp, sleep and confusion moves, Leech Seed, Protect, Endure, recovery, Rest, screens, weather, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Defog, Haze, Roar, Curse, Perish Song, Attract, Tailwind, Trick, Counter, Heal Bell, Follow Me and Focus Energy.
Not if the AI holds a Mental Herb or has Aroma Veil on its side.
notes: Substitute, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Taunt, Encore, Disable, Wish, Trick Room, terrains, Yawn, Destiny Bond and Baton Pass are still scored.

entries.name: Stealth Rock, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web
rules: +0 if you know a setup move (Swords Dance, Dragon Dance, Calm Mind, Iron Defense...)
+0 if you can KO the AI in 2 hits or fewer
Otherwise:
If first turn out: +4
Else: +2
notes: Only if you have a Pokémon in the back and none of your Pokémon has Rapid Spin, Defog, Court Change, Tidy Up or Mortal Spin. Magic Coat or Magic Bounce also stop it. Stone Axe and Ceaseless Edge get the same +4 / +2, without the setup-move and 2-hit checks.

entries.name: Defog
rules: If hazards are on the AI's side and it has a Pokémon in the back, or your side has Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard or Mist:
Else: scored by the evasion drop, usually +0
If you have hazards on your side: -10 (it will not clear them for you)

entries.name: Court Change
rules: +2 if hazards are on the AI's side and it has a Pokémon in the back
+1 if your side has screens, Safeguard, Mist or Tailwind
-10 if you have hazards and it has Pokémon left

entries.name: Protect, Detect, King's Shield, Spiky Shield, Baneful Bunker, Silk Trap, Burning Bulwark
rules: If it did not protect last turn:
If your last move was an attack: +2
If it protected last turn:
Singles: -1 per use in a row (at most -3)
Doubles: -2 per use in a row (at most -6)
If the AI is taking residual damage (poison, burn, Leech Seed, Curse, Salt Cure, bind, Perish Song):
Additional -1
If you are taking residual damage:
Additional +2
King's Shield on Aegislash Blade Forme, if you are not incapacitated:
notes: Check Bad Move also applies: -10 if you are asleep or frozen, your last move goes through Protect, or it would faint to residual damage anyway. After one successful Protect there is a 50% chance of -6 (singles); after two in a row, -10.
Quick Guard is scored only when your last move had priority, Wide Guard only when it hit both sides, Mat Block only on its first turn.

entries.name: Endure
rules: Only if you can KO the AI:
+3 if it has more than 25% HP and holds a pinch berry (Liechi, Salac, Petaya, Starf...)
Else +3 if it has Flail, Reversal or Endeavor

entries.name: Substitute, Shed Tail
rules: Substitute: +3 if your best hit does less than 25% of its max HP
Shed Tail: +4 if your best hit does less than 50% of its max HP
Both:
Additional +3 if you are under Perish Song
Additional +3 if you are asleep, else +2 if you are poisoned or burned
Additional +3 if you have a sleep, Toxic, paralysis, burn, confusion or Leech Seed move
Additional +1 if it has more than 70% HP
Already behind a Substitute, or you have Infiltrator or a move that goes through Substitute: -8
If you can KO it in 4 hits or fewer: -10

entries.name: Thunder Wave, Stun Spore, Glare
rules: If you are faster but less than twice as fast, or it has Hex or a flinching move (not Fake Out), or you are infatuated or confused:
Else:
notes: Like every status-inflicting move: +0 if the AI can already KO you this turn, or you hold the matching cure berry or a Lum Berry.

entries.name: Will-O-Wisp
rules: If you have a physical move:
If one of the AI's own best moves is physical: +2
Else: +1
If the AI or its partner has Hex or Infernal Parade:
Additional +1
notes: The +2/+1 split looks at the AI's moves, not yours. Against a Pokémon with no physical moves, Will-O-Wisp scores +0 unless the AI has Hex.

entries.name: Toxic, Poison Powder, Toxic Thread
rules: Only if you can be poisoned and have more than 20% HP
If you have no damaging moves:
If the AI has Venoshock, Barb Barrage, Hex, Infernal Parade, Venom Drench or Merciless:
Additional +2
Else:
Additional +1
notes: Toxic usually ends at +1.

entries.name: Sleep moves (Spore, Hypnosis, Sleep Powder, Sing, Dark Void...) and Yawn
rules: +0 if you hold a Chesto or Lum Berry, or the AI can KO you this turn
If you can be put to sleep:
If the AI has Dream Eater or Nightmare and you have no Sleep Talk or Snore:
Additional +1
If the AI or its partner has Wake-Up Slap or Hex:
Additional +1

entries.name: Confuse Ray, Supersonic, Sweet Kiss, Teeter Dance
rules: If you are paralyzed or infatuated, or the AI has Serene Grace and a flinching move:
Else:

entries.name: Swagger, Flatter
rules: Confusion score, plus:
+2 if the AI's side has Foul Play, Psych Up or Spectral Thief
+3 if you have Contrary

entries.name: Leech Seed
rules: +0 if you are Grass type, already seeded, or have Rapid Spin, Liquid Ooze or Magic Guard
Else: +3
Additional +2 if you have no damaging moves, are trapped, or the AI holds a Big Root
notes: "Trapped" includes being your last Pokémon. Into Liquid Ooze: -3.

entries.name: Curse (Ghost type)
rules: If you are trapped (including your last Pokémon): +3
Else: +1
At 50% HP or less: -10

entries.name: Attract
rules: If you already have a status, are confused or are trapped: +3
Else: +2

entries.name: Should the AI recover?
rules: Never at full HP.
If AI is faster:
Yes if you can KO it now but not after it heals
Yes 50% of the time if you cannot KO it and it is below 60% HP
If AI is slower:
Yes if you cannot KO it, your best hit is smaller than the heal, and the heal makes you need another hit
Yes 50% of the time if you cannot KO it and it is below 60% HP
notes: A slower AI that you can KO this turn never gets a recovery bonus.

entries.name: Recover, Slack Off, Soft-Boiled, Milk Drink, Roost, Morning Sun, Synthesis, Moonlight
rules: If it should recover (healing 50%): +3
At full HP: -10. At 90% or more: -9
Morning Sun, Synthesis, Moonlight in rain, sand, hail, snow or fog: Additional -3

entries.name: Other healing moves
rules: Shore Up: +2 if it should recover
Strength Sap: +3 if it should recover (heal = your Attack), +1 more with Big Root
Swallow: +2 if it should recover; -5 at 80% HP or more
Wish (singles): +2 if any of its party is below 65% HP
Heal Bell, Aromatherapy: +2 if a party member has a status worth curing
Pain Split: +0

entries.name: Rest
rules: Only if it can fall asleep and should recover (healing 100%):
Holding a Chesto or Lum Berry, or Hydration in rain: +4
Else, with Sleep Talk or Snore: +3
Else, with Shed Skin or Early Bird: +2
Else: +0

entries.name: Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil
rules: If you have a matching move (physical for Reflect, special for Light Screen; Aurora Veil needs hail or snow) and the screen is not up:
Additional +2 with Light Clay
+0 if you have Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, Defog or another screen-breaking move

entries.name: Tailwind
rules: +0 if Trick Room is up with more than 1 turn left
Singles: the Speed setup score if doubled Speed would outspeed you (+2 only if it is slower and you need 3+ hits to KO it)
Additional +1 if it has a Pokémon in the back
Additional +1 if its side has Electro Ball
Doubles: +1 for each pair whose speed order flips, +1 more if any do

entries.name: Trick Room
rules: Not up, and the AI is slower than you: +3
Not up, the AI is not slower, and it has a Pokémon in the back: +2
Already up with more than 1 turn left, and the AI is now faster: +3

entries.name: Rain Dance, Sunny Day, Sandstorm, Hail, Snowscape
rules: If the weather helps its side and is not already up: +2
Additional +1 each for Weather Ball, the matching rock (Damp Rock, Heat Rock, Smooth Rock, Icy Rock), and weather that weakens your moves or healing
notes: Weather helps when it has a weather Ability (Swift Swim, Chlorophyll, Sand Rush, Ice Body...), moves boosted by it, or types that resist the damage. Weather that is already up: -8.

entries.name: Electric, Grassy, Misty, Psychic Terrain
rules: If the terrain helps its side: +3
Electric or Misty while it is drowsy from Yawn and grounded: Additional +4
With Terrain Extender or Terrain Pulse: Additional +1

entries.name: Taunt
rules: If your last move was a status move: +3
Else, if you have any status move: +2

entries.name: Encore
rules: If you are not already Encored, have no Mental Herb, and your last move was worth locking (setup, status, recovery, Protect, poison or paralysis moves):
If it moves first and you have not used a move yet: -10

entries.name: Disable
rules: If the AI is faster and your last move can OHKO it (and you are not already disabled, no Mental Herb): +3
If it moves first and you have not used a move yet: -10

entries.name: Trick, Switcheroo
rules: By the AI's held item:
Choice Scarf: +2
Choice Band: +2 if you have no physical move. Choice Specs: +2 if you have no special move
Toxic Orb, Flame Orb: +2 unless it benefits from the status
Black Sludge: +2 against a non-Poison Pokémon without Magic Guard
Iron Ball: +2 if you have no Fling or are not grounded
Lagging Tail, Sticky Barb: +2
Holding nothing while you hold an item: +1 for most items

entries.name: Destiny Bond
rules: If AI is faster and you can KO it: +3

entries.name: Perish Song, Mean Look, Block
rules: Perish Song: +3 if you are trapped (including your last Pokémon)
Mean Look, Block, Spider Web: +3 only if you can be trapped and will faint to residual damage

entries.name: Haze, Roar, Whirlwind
rules: +1 for each of your raised stats (counting stats, not stages), at most +4
Haze: -10 for each of its own raised stats and each of your lowered stats
Roar, Whirlwind: +0 against Soundproof (Roar) or Suction Cups

entries.name: Baton Pass
rules: If it wants to switch and has a Substitute, Aqua Ring, Ingrain, Magnet Rise, Power Trick or any raised stat: +4
Nothing worth passing: -6

entries.name: Memento
rules: Will Suicide trainers only: +2 if your evasion is not raised
Everyone else: +0

entries.name: Other status moves
rules: Psych Up: +1 if you have a higher stage in a stat it can use
Magic Coat: +3 if your last move can be bounced
Safeguard: +2 unless it is grounded in Misty Terrain
Heal Block: +2 if you have a healing move, Leftovers, or Black Sludge as a Poison type
Embargo: +2 if you hold an item
Imprison: +2 if your last move is one it also knows, else +1 after the first turn
Follow Me, Rage Powder (doubles): +3 if its partner's last move was an attack and you are not incapacitated

intro: Any status move without a rule here (Pain Split, Spite, Torment, Acupressure, Helping Hand in singles...) stays at +0. It ties with every attack except the best one.

entries.name: Growl, Charm, Feather Dance, Tickle, Noble Roar, Eerie Impulse, Confide
rules: Lowers Attack and you have a physical move: -10
Lowers Sp. Atk and you have a special move: -10
Otherwise: +0
notes: The AI reads the amount these moves lower as if it were a raise, so it avoids lowering the attacking stat you actually use. This is how the code works, not a design choice.

entries.name: Screech, Scary Face, String Shot, Cotton Spore, Fake Tears, Metal Sound, Sand Attack, Smokescreen, Flash
notes: Only against a Contrary Pokémon do stat-lowering status moves get the bonuses listed under "Guaranteed side effects".

sections.title: Moves the AI avoids

entries.name: Asleep
rules: While asleep and not waking this turn, if it knows Sleep Talk or Snore, every other move: -20
Sleep Talk and Snore when it is awake or about to wake: -10
notes: This is a Black Pearl Emerald change. Before it, a sleeping Pokémon could pick a KO move over Sleep Talk and waste the turn.

entries.name: Your semi-invulnerable turn
rules: If you are in the air, underground or underwater and the AI moves first, moves that cannot hit you: -10

entries.name: Focus Punch bait
rules: If your best move against it is Focus Punch, its status moves (except sleep moves): -20 (50%)

entries.name: Frozen target
rules: Moves that would thaw you, unless super effective: -1 (if it has another move)

entries.name: Magic Guard
rules: Leech Seed, Ghost-type Curse, poison, Toxic and burn moves into Magic Guard: -5

entries.name: Low HP setup
rules: Ghost-type Curse at 50% HP or less: -10
Belly Drum or Fillet Away at 60% HP or less, or into Unaware: -10
Clangorous Soul at 50% HP or less: -10

entries.name: Choice items
rules: Moves that target itself (Swords Dance...): -30, except Destiny Bond, Wish, Healing Wish and Aurora Veil in hail or snow
Status moves when it is the last Pokémon, has no good switch-in, or is trapped: -30

entries.name: Status moves the AI judges useless
rules: Poison, paralysis and burn moves when the status would not help: -5

entries.name: Phazing and pivoting
rules: Roar, Whirlwind with no Pokémon in your back or into Suction Cups: -10
Dragon Tail, Circle Throw when you are under 10% HP and taking residual damage, or under Perish Song: -10
Teleport: always -10

entries.name: Powder and Prankster
rules: Powder moves into Grass types, Overcoat or Safety Goggles: -10
Prankster status moves into Dark types: -10

intro: These penalties come from Check Bad Move: -20 for a move that does nothing, -10 for a move that fails, and smaller penalties for moves that are probably pointless. Only the cases that are not obvious are listed.

entries.name: Will Suicide (Leader Dan, Leader CMT)
rules: Explosion-type moves, Final Gambit, Memento, Healing Wish and Lunar Dance always count as KO options, with no HP roll.
Explosion-type moves and Memento: Additional +2 if your evasion is not raised.
Final Gambit: Additional +2.
notes: Only Leader CMT's teams know a self-sacrifice move (Explosion), so the flag changes nothing for Leader Dan.

entries.name: Prefer Status Moves (Champion Pantelis)
rules: Every status move that is not blocked by type immunity: Additional +10
notes: Moves that would fail still lose their -10 from Check Bad Move, cancelling the bonus.

entries.name: Ace Pokémon (Champion Pantelis, one Aqua Hideout Grunt)
rules: The last Pokémon in the party is never a switch-in target and is never sent in after a faint while any other Pokémon can battle.
Roar, Whirlwind and Dragon Tail can still force it in.

entries.name: Aqua Hideout Grunt without Smart Switching
rules: Not Omniscient: it only knows moves you have used.
Uses only the simple switch reasons: Wonder Guard, Truant, all moves useless, Perish Song, Natural Cure, Regenerator, Zero to Hero and Choice lock.
Chooses switch-ins the simple way listed under "Double Battles".
